payload_json.geometry: Pulse damage emitted along the illusion's path (lane-shaped). Pulses cannot overlap — single-target damage is inherently limited. Teleport endpoint deals area damage at final position. Illusion constrained within range of player (~62 units max). Player considered stationary while channeling.

dossier.anchor_quote: While Channeling this Skill you release an illusion of yourself that follows your cursor, emits damaging pulses, and accumulates stages. Upon ceasing the channel, you will teleport to the location of the illusion.

payload_json.loop: Channel the skill while steering the cursor to project an illusion forward. The illusion travels at 130% of player movement speed along the cursor path, emitting pulse damage waves along its trajectory and accumulating stages. Releasing the channel teleports the player to the illusion's position and delivers a final damage burst scaled by stages accumulated. Considered channeled movement-attack hybrid.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: NEGATIVE kit (confirmed intrinsic design flaw). The identity is a COMPOUND: (1) a channelled, cursor-STEERED illusion that is NOT the player; (2) pulse damage along its lane path that CANNOT OVERLAP (so single-target is inherently weak — the flaw); (3) a teleport-to-illusion-endpoint burst that CANNOT BE CANCELLED (the danger-flaw). Engine dash_attack is a movement-primary reposition with incidental contact — it lands the 'strike-by-moving' skeleton and the reposition, but FLATTENS the steerable-phantom-you-pilot, the along-the-path pulse emission, and — critically — the two mechanics that MAKE it a negative kit (non-overlapping pulses gating single-target; uncancellable teleport). A Charged Dash player would not recognise the piloted-illusion feel or the exact awkwardness that defined the skill. persistent_condition_shape=tick-cost carries the channel; stage-accumulation is the charge-analog. PHASE_MOMENTUM for the movement-as-offense capstone reading. No mint: the compound is approximable, and minting a 'steerable-phantom-with-non-overlapping-lane-pulses' mechanism to reproduce a KNOWN-BAD negative kit is against parsimony — the flaw is the point of cataloguing it, not of building it.
